title: erodium petraeum subsp. crispum
intro: Erodium petraeum subsp. crispum, commonly known as the Alpine Storksbill, is a plant species in the Geranium family. It is a perennial herb with a history of traditional use in folk medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Erodium petraeum subsp. crispum include its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues, as well as its potential to protect against cell damage and promote wound healing. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
